title: The critical correlation power of the nearest-neighbor planar XY model
exact_target: For the nearest-neighbor planar XY model at its physical critical inverse temperature, does log $C_{b_c}(r)/\log $ r tend to $-1/4$ along integer axial separations r$\to$infinity? This question asks only the power, without an amplitude limit or prescribed logarithmic factor.
